Nordex Group to enter Albania with 84 MW order from Verbund

2026-11-09 / 07:30 CET/CEST

The issuer is solely responsible for the content of this announcement.

Hamburg, 9 November 2026. The Nordex Group is entering the Albanian market for the first time. The company has received an order from Austrian energy company VERBUND for the supply and installation of twelve N163/6.X wind turbines for an 84 MW wind farm, project Spille, in Albania. The contract also includes a 15-year Premium Service agreement.

In January 2026, the companies signed a multi-year framework agreement covering the potential supply of up to 700 MW of wind turbines for projects in six European markets.

About VERBUND
VERBUND is headquartered in Austria and active in 12 countries.

About the Nordex Group
The Group has commissioned more than 67 GW of wind power capacity in over 40 markets.
